facts.fact: The government officially launched on 19 December 2025 a digitalised service for civil-status acts, a pilot in five communes (Golfe 1, Agoe-Nyive 1, Ave 2, Lacs 1, Zio 2) for progressive national deployment, run by the territorial administration ministry and MESPTN through Agence Togo Digital.

systems.owner: MATGLAC; MESPTN via Agence Togo Digital
